BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gᵉdîyâh means kids, young female goats. It occurs just once, in Song of Solomon.
TheologicalSignificance: I read gᵉdîyâh plainly: kids, young female goats, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
